sources: https://symphonyfintech.com/marketdata/doc/ (official XTS Market Data API spec, data.json): /auth/login, /config/clientConfig, /instruments/master, /instruments/indexlist, /instruments/quotes (1502, 1510), /instruments/ohlc, Rate Limit

https://symphonyfintech.com/interactive/doc/ (official XTS Interactive API spec, data.json): /user/session, /user/balance, /orders (place, modify, cancel, order book), /orders/trades, /portfolio/positions, /portfolio/holdings, enums, Rate Limit

notes: Derived from the shared XTS fixture set (official Symphony XTS doc samples, dummy ids), re-pointed at this broker's host and its /apimarketdata market-data path. Every capability file also answers the logins and masters, because sessions and masters are cached by the first call that needs them.
